title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). translated_title: 重新思考对比解码在多模态大语言模型幻觉缓解中的评估
translated_abstract: 对比解码通过在不同条件下对比token分布来调整token分数，从而缓解多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的对象幻觉问题。然而，现有的生成式和判别式基准主要衡量最终任务分数，这些分数可能受到候选过滤、生成轨迹变化和响应偏差的干扰，使得难以隔离底层对比调整的实际效果。为了在补充现有评估的同时解决这些局限性，我们引入了CONCOR（对比纠正评估），这是一个受控基准，通过对比接地边际直接评估真值候选与不同类型幻觉候选之间的竞争情况。CGM还支持对对比纠正的方向一致性、组成方式和可靠性进行分析。我们的评估揭示了现有对比解码方法表现出的明显差异（摘要内容截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了CONCOR受控评估基准，利用对比接地边际直接衡量对比解码方法在多模态大语言模型幻觉缓解中的真实效果，克服了现有基准无法隔离底层对比调整作用的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CONCOR, a controlled benchmark that uses the Contrastive Grounding Margin to directly evaluate the effectiveness of contrastive decoding methods for hallucination mitigation in multimodal large language models, addressing the confounding limitations of existing evaluation benchmarks.
